name: Decline Crunch
steps: Set an adjustable bench to a decline, hook your feet under the pads, and lie back.
Cross your arms over your chest or place fingertips lightly beside your temples.
Exhale and curl your rib cage toward your pelvis until your shoulder blades clear the pad.
Uncurl slowly under control until your upper back rests back on the bench.
tips: Keep your lower back against the pad and chin slightly off your chest.
Avoid pulling on your neck or swinging your torso up with momentum.
